items.headline: Board Update
items.text: Disclaimer* Smarter Web Company PLC (The) 28 October 2026 28 October 2026 The Smarter Web Company PLC ("The Smarter Web Company" or the "Company") Board Update The Smarter Web Company is pleased to announce the appointment of Oliver Hewett to the Board as an Executive Director, with immediate effect. Additionally, Tyler Evans has stepped down as Non-Executive Director, with immediate effect. Appointment of Oliver Hewett to the Board Oliver joined the Company as Group Financial Controller in April 2026 and was subsequently promoted to Chief Financial Officer ("CFO") in June 2026. Since joining, he has become an increasingly important member of the senior leadership team, making a significant contribution to the Company's financial management, corporate governance and strategic development. His appointment to the Board reflects the value of his contribution to date, the breadth of his responsibilities and the Board's confidence in his ability to support the Company's long-term ambitions. Oliver brings almost two decades of financial experience spanning institutional investment banking and SME leadership. A Fellow of the Institute of Chartered Accountants in England and Wales, Oliver previously held positions at Barclays Capital, Bank of America Merrill Lynch and NatWest Markets, where he supported the financial execution of RBS's £29bn Capital Resolution programme. Prior to joining the Company, Oliver also served as CFO and board director at two growing UK SMEs, supporting acquisitions, revenue growth and operational scale-up. As an Executive Director, Oliver will continue in his role as CFO, working closely with Andrew Webley, CEO, and the wider Board on the execution of the Company's strategy and 10 Year Plan. There is no information required to be disclosed under UKLR 6.4.8R in respect of Oliver Hewett. Departure of Tyler Evans from the Board The Company announces that Tyler Evans has stepped down from his position as Non-Executive Director to focus on his other business interests. The Board would like to express its sincere appreciation to Tyler for his support and contribution during the Company's transition to becoming a publicly listed business in April 2025 and throughout its initial stages as a public company. The Board is grateful for his involvement during this important period in the Company's history and wishes him every success in the future. Andrew Webley, CEO, The Smarter Web Company, commented : "I am delighted to welcome Oliver to the Board. Since joining us, he has become an incredibly important part of the Company, and his experience, judgement and contribution have been invaluable. His appointment is thoroughly deserved and reflects the confidence I have in him as we continue to execute our 10 Year Plan. "I would also like to personally thank Tyler for his support and contribution during the early stages of our journey as a public company. He will always be considered a friend of The Smarter Web Company. I wish him every success for the future." Enquiries The Smarter Web Company CEO / CFO Andrew Webley / Oliver Hewett +44 (0) 117 313 0459 Tennyson Securities Broker Peter Krens +44 (0) 207 186 9030 Strand Hanson Limited Financial Adviser James Bellman / Abigail Wennington +44 (0) 207 409 3494 This announcement is made in accordance with UKLR 6.4.6R. About The Smarter Web Company The Company owns and operates digital services businesses focused on web design, development and digital marketing. The Company serves more than 500 client websites across a diverse range of sectors and generates a significant and growing proportion of its revenue through long-term client relationships and retained service arrangements. The Company's strategy combines the operation and acquisition of cash-generative businesses with a Bitcoin treasury policy designed to build long-term Shareholder value (the "Bitcoin Treasury Policy"). The Directors believe that Bitcoin will form a significant part of the future global financial system and have therefore adopted this Bitcoin Treasury Policy under which Bitcoin is the Company's primary treasury reserve asset. The primary objectives of the Bitcoin Treasury Policy are to support the Company's overall capital position and to seek to increase Bitcoin per Ordinary Share over time, with a secondary objective of increasing the total number of Bitcoin held on the Company's balance sheet. The Directors believe that growing Bitcoin per share while simultaneously increasing the scale of the Company's Bitcoin holdings creates a stronger balance sheet and supports the Company as a whole in providing a more attractive investment proposition for existing and prospective Shareholders. As the strength of the balance sheet increases, the Company believes it can access larger pools of capital on favourable terms, provided such capital raising activity remains accretive to Bitcoin per Ordinary Share. This creates a cycle in which capital can be deployed to pursue strategic acquisitions and acquire additional Bitcoin that strengthen the Company's operating businesses, increase revenues and cash generation, and further enhance the overall strength of the Company. The Ordinary Shares are admitted to listing on the equity shares (commercial companies) category of the Official List and to trading on the Main Market of the London Stock Exchange under the ticker SWC and are quoted on the OTCQB Venture Market in the U.S. under the ticker TSWCF. The Ordinary Shares can also be traded on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange under the ticker 3M8. The Preferred Shares are admitted to listing on the non-equity shares and non-voting equity shares category of the Official List and to trading on the Main Market of the London Stock Exchange under the ticker MORE. Please also see "The 10 Year Plan", announced by the Company via regulatory information service at 7.00 a.m. on 28 April 2025 and available on the Company's website: https://www.smarterwebcompany.co.uk Follow the Company on X: https://x.com/smarterwebuk The Smarter Web Company's Legal Entity Identifier (LEI) is 213800VQO9FUG4PZMP73. The Directors of the Company accept responsibility for the contents of this announcement. Important Notice The Smarter Web Company Plc holds treasury reserves and surplus cash in Bitcoin. Bitcoin is a type of cryptocurrency or cryptoasset. Whilst the Board of Directors of the Company considers holding Bitcoin to be in the best interests of the Company, the Board remains aware that the financial regulator in the UK (the Financial Conduct Authority or FCA) considers investment in Bitcoin to be high risk. An investment in the Company is not an investment in Bitcoin, either directly or by proxy. However, the Board of Directors of the Company consider Bitcoin to be an appropriate store of value and growth for the Company's reserves and, accordingly, the Company is materially exposed to Bitcoin. Such an approach is innovative, and the Board of Directors of the Company wish to be clear and transparent with prospective and actual investors in the Company on the Company's position in this regard. The Company is neither authorised nor regulated in the conduct of its business by the FCA. And there is currently limited regulation of cryptocurrencies (such as Bitcoin) in the UK. As with most other investments, the value of Bitcoin can go down as well as up, and therefore the value of the Company's Bitcoin holdings can fluctuate. The Company may not be able to realise its Bitcoin exposure for the same as it paid in the first place or even for the value the Company ascribes to its Bitcoin positions due to these market movements. An investment in the Company is not protected by the UK's Financial Ombudsman Service or the Financial Services Compensation Scheme. Nevertheless, the Board of Directors of the Company has taken the decision to invest in Bitcoin, and in doing so is mindful of the special risks Bitcoin presents to the Company's financial position. These risks include (but are not limited to): (i) the value of Bitcoin can be highly volatile, with value dropping as quickly as it can rise. Investors in Bitcoin must be prepared to lose all money invested in Bitcoin; (ii) the Bitcoin market is largely unregulated. There is a risk of losing money due to risks such as cyber-attacks, financial crime and counterparty failure; (iii) the Company may not be able to buy or sell its Bitcoin at will. The ability to buy or sell Bitcoin depends on various factors, including the supply and demand in the market at the relevant time. Operational failings such as technology outages, cyber-attacks and comingling of funds could cause unwanted delay; and (iv) cryptoassets are characterised in some quarters by high degrees of fraud, money laundering and financial crime. In addition, there is a perception in some quarters that cyber-attacks are prominent which can lead to theft of holdings or ransom demands. The Board of Directors of the Company does not subscribe to such a negative view, especially in relation to Bitcoin. However, prospective investors in the Company are encouraged to do your own research before investing. This information is provided by RNS, the news service of the London Stock Exchange. items.headline: MORE Weekly Dividend: Preferred Dividend Rate 12%
items.text: Disclaimer* Smarter Web Company PLC (The) 27 October 2026 27 October 2026 The Smarter Web Company PLC ("The Smarter Web Company" or the "Company") MORE Weekly Dividend: Preferred Dividend Rate 12% The Smarter Web Company notes that the weekly Preferred Dividend (ISIN: GB00C0HJ0D12; TIDM: MORE) for the week ending Friday 30 October 2026 will be £0.2301 per Preferred Share. The record date will be Friday 30 October 2026, with an ex-dividend date of Thursday 29 October 2026. The payment date will be Monday 16 November 2026, in line with the expected timetable set out in Appendix 1 to the Company's announcement of 12 October 2026. As previously announced by the Company, the Preferred Shares have attached to them a right for the holder to receive a cumulative variable rate weekly preferential dividend (" Preferred Dividend "), a liquidation preference, and a right for the Company to redeem the Preferred Shares, but no right to vote at a general meeting of shareholders of the Company. The Preferred Dividend Rate is currently 12% per annum of £100 (being the Preferred Dividend Reference Amount as defined in the Company's articles of association). The Board may vary the Preferred Dividend Rate within the parameters described in the prospectus published by the Company on 29 September 2026, and any change to the Preferred Dividend Rate will be announced via a Regulatory Information Service before the first record date to which it applies. As at the date of this announcement, 111,137 of the 211,112 Preferred Shares in issue are entitled to receive the dividend (with no waiver of that entitlement having been received by the Company). The remaining 99,975 Preferred Shares are held by or on behalf of Tennyson Capital under the Company's at-the-market facility for the Preferred Shares (the "Preferred Shares ATM Facility" ). Tennyson Capital has waived the right to receive any dividend that would be due to it as a holder of Preferred Shares, and accordingly such waiver will apply until those Preferred Shares are sold by or on behalf of Tennyson Capital. The Company will provide a further update on 29 October 2026 if any additional Preferred Shares have been sold pursuant to the Preferred Shares ATM Facility. Diluted Market Cap is defined as the Company's current share price multiplied by the fully diluted shares in issue. items.headline: Ordinary and Preferred Shares ATM Update
items.text: Disclaimer* Smarter Web Company PLC (The) 22 October 2026 22 October 2026 The Smarter Web Company PLC ("The Smarter Web Company" or the "Company") Ordinary and Preferred Shares ATM Update - £0.6m Gross Proceeds The Smarter Web Company announces that 1,076,000 Ordinary Shares and 25 Preferred Shares have been sold since 14 October 2026, being the date on which the Preferred Shares were admitted to listing and trading on the Main Market of the London Stock Exchange under the Company's at-the-market facilities, being the "Ordinary Shares ATM Facility" (as announced on 24 December 2025) and the "Preferred Shares ATM Facility" (as described in the Company's prospectus published on 29 September 2026). The aggregate gross proceeds from the sale of Ordinary Shares and Preferred Shares amount to £592,679. Ordinary Shares ATM Facility · Ordinary Shares sold: 1,076,000 · Net proceeds: £579,850 · Average sale price per Ordinary Share: £0.55 · Ordinary Shares issued under the Ordinary Shares ATM Facility and remaining unsold: 36,416,788 Preferred Shares ATM Facility · Preferred Shares sold: 25 · Net proceeds: £2,475 · Average sale price per Preferred Share: £100 · Preferred Shares issued under the Preferred Shares ATM Facility and remaining unsold: 99,975 Enquiries The Smarter Web Company CEO / CFO Andrew Webley / Oliver Hewett +44 (0) 117 313 0459 Tennyson Securities Broker Peter Krens +44 (0) 207 186 9030 Strand Hanson Limited Financial Adviser James Bellman / Abigail Wennington +44 (0) 207 409 3494 About The Smarter Web Company The Company owns and operates digital services businesses focused on web design, development and digital marketing. The Company serves more than 500 client websites across a diverse range of sectors and generates a significant and growing proportion of its revenue through long-term client relationships and retained service arrangements. The Company's strategy combines the operation and acquisition of cash-generative businesses with a Bitcoin treasury policy designed to build long-term Shareholder value (the "Bitcoin Treasury Policy"). The Directors believe that Bitcoin will form a significant part of the future global financial system and have therefore adopted this Bitcoin Treasury Policy under which Bitcoin is the Company's primary treasury reserve asset. The primary objectives of the Bitcoin Treasury Policy are to support the Company's overall capital position and to seek to increase Bitcoin per Ordinary Share over time, with a secondary objective of increasing the total number of Bitcoin held on the Company's balance sheet. The Directors believe that growing Bitcoin per share while simultaneously increasing the scale of the Company's Bitcoin holdings creates a stronger balance sheet and supports the Company as a whole in providing a more attractive investment proposition for existing and prospective Shareholders. As the strength of the balance sheet increases, the Company believes it can access larger pools of capital on favourable terms, provided such capital raising activity remains accretive to Bitcoin per Ordinary Share. This creates a cycle in which capital can be deployed to pursue strategic acquisitions and acquire additional Bitcoin that strengthen the Company's operating businesses, increase revenues and cash generation, and further enhance the overall strength of the Company. The Ordinary Shares are admitted to listing on the equity shares (commercial companies) category of the Official List and to trading on the Main Market of the London Stock Exchange under the ticker SWC and are quoted on the OTCQB Venture Market in the U.S. under the ticker TSWCF. The Ordinary Shares can also be traded on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange under the ticker 3M8. The Preferred Shares are admitted to listing on the non-equity shares and non-voting equity shares category of the Official List and to trading on the Main Market of the London Stock Exchange under the ticker MORE. Please also see "The 10 Year Plan", announced by the Company via a regulatory information service at 7.00 a.m. on 28 April 2025 and available on the Company's website: https://www.smarterwebcompany.co.uk Follow the Company on X: https://x.com/smarterwebuk The Smarter Web Company's Legal Entity Identifier (LEI) is 213800VQO9FUG4PZMP73. The Directors of the Company accept responsibility for the contents of this announcement. Important Notice The Smarter Web Company PLC holds treasury reserves and surplus cash in Bitcoin. Bitcoin is a type of cryptocurrency or cryptoasset. Whilst the Board of Directors of the Company considers holding Bitcoin to be in the best interests of the Company, the Board remains aware that the financial regulator in the UK (the Financial Conduct Authority or FCA) considers investment in Bitcoin to be high risk. An investment in the Company is not an investment in Bitcoin, either directly or by proxy. However, the Board of Directors of the Company considers Bitcoin to be an appropriate store of value and growth for the Company's reserves and, accordingly, the Company is materially exposed to Bitcoin. Such an approach is innovative, and the Board of Directors of the Company wishes to be clear and transparent with prospective and actual investors in the Company on the Company's position in this regard. The Company is neither authorised nor regulated in the conduct of its business by the FCA, and there is currently limited regulation of cryptocurrencies (such as Bitcoin) in the UK. As with most other investments, the value of Bitcoin can go down as well as up, and therefore the value of the Company's Bitcoin holdings can fluctuate. The Company may not be able to realise its Bitcoin exposure for the same as it paid in the first place or even for the value the Company ascribes to its Bitcoin positions due to these market movements. An investment in the Company is not protected by the UK's Financial Ombudsman Service or the Financial Services Compensation Scheme. Nevertheless, the Board of Directors of the Company has taken the decision to invest in Bitcoin, and in doing so is mindful of the special risks Bitcoin presents to the Company's financial position. These risks include (but are not limited to): (i) the value of Bitcoin can be highly volatile, with value dropping as quickly as it can rise. Investors in Bitcoin must be prepared to lose all money invested in Bitcoin; (ii) the Bitcoin market is largely unregulated. There is a risk of losing money due to risks such as cyber-attacks, financial crime and counterparty failure; (iii) the Company may not be able to buy or sell its Bitcoin at will. The ability to buy or sell Bitcoin depends on various factors, including the supply and demand in the market at the relevant time. Operational failings such as technology outages, cyber-attacks and comingling of funds could cause unwanted delay; and (iv) cryptoassets are characterised in some quarters by high degrees of fraud, money laundering and financial crime. In addition, there is a perception in some quarters that cyber-attacks are prominent, which can lead to theft of holdings or ransom demands. The Board of Directors of the Company does not subscribe to such a negative view, especially in relation to Bitcoin. However, prospective investors in the Company are encouraged to do their own research before investing. This information is provided by RNS, the news service of the London Stock Exchange. items.headline: MORE Weekly Dividend: Preferred Dividend Rate 12%
items.text: Disclaimer* Smarter Web Company PLC (The) 20 October 2026 20 October 2026 The Smarter Web Company PLC ("The Smarter Web Company" or the "Company") MORE Weekly Dividend: Preferred Dividend Rate 12% The Smarter Web Company notes that the weekly Preferred Dividend (ISIN: GB00C0HJ0D12; TIDM: MORE) for the week ending Friday 23 October 2026 will be £0.2301 per Preferred Share. The record date will be Friday 23 October 2026, with an ex-dividend date of Thursday 22 October 2026. The payment date will be Monday 9 November 2026, in line with the expected timetable set out in Appendix 1 to the Company's announcement of 12 October 2026. As previously announced by the Company, the Preferred Shares have attached to them a right for the holder to receive a cumulative variable rate weekly preferential dividend (" Preferred Dividend "), a liquidation preference, and a right for the Company to redeem the Preferred Shares, but no right to vote at a general meeting of shareholders of the Company. The Preferred Dividend Rate is currently 12% per annum of £100 (being the Preferred Dividend Reference Amount as defined in the Company's articles of association). The Board may vary the Preferred Dividend Rate within the parameters described in the prospectus published by the Company on 29 September 2026, and any change to the Preferred Dividend Rate will be announced via a Regulatory Information Service before the first record date to which it applies. As at the date of this announcement, 111,112 of the 211,112 Preferred Shares in issue are entitled to receive the dividend (with no waiver of that entitlement having been received by the Company). The remaining 100,000 Preferred Shares are held by or on behalf of Tennyson Capital under the Company's at-the-market facility for the Preferred Shares (the "Preferred Shares ATM Facility" ). Tennyson Capital has waived the right to receive any dividend that would be due to it as a holder of Preferred Shares, and accordingly such waiver will apply until those Preferred Shares are sold by or on behalf of Tennyson Capital. The Company will provide a further update on 22 October 2026 if any additional Preferred Shares have been sold pursuant to the Preferred Shares ATM Facility.
